cases.name: EF-REG-007 - Connected decision failure leaves source record unmodified
cases.reason: No EFREG007 connected record or associated Action Center task was present in fresh server queries. The available demo=fail-decide switch is an app-layer rehearsal hook that throws before any UiPath call and does not prove a connected task-completion failure. No task corruption, orphan creation, or fault injection was attempted.

cases.name: EF-REG-008 - Connected Finance attention classification covers all unsettled reasons

steps.comment: Inserted five uniquely tagged synthetic records with 0 failures; fresh Finance-status query returned all five expected combinations.
Connected Finance loaded and refreshed after the ExpenseDate fix; Policy Review, Pending Approval, Needs Rework, and Missing Receipt rendered, while the Submitted-with-receipt control was excluded.
Edge visual masking/COM transport failure and a fresh tab retaining ?mock=1 prevented trusted connected detail-route readback; no business mutation was performed.

cases.name: EF-REG-009 - Connected service errors expose retryable user feedback
cases.reason: No EFREG009 connected recovery fixture was present in a fresh server query. The available demo=fail-submit and demo=fail-decide switches bypass UiPath calls and therefore are not evidence of a connected read/write failure. Unsafe network denial, credential manipulation, request tampering, and deliberate service fault injection were not attempted.

cases.name: EF-REG-010 - Connected receipt access failures are contained and recoverable
cases.reason: No approved safe connected receipt access-denied/unavailable fixture exists. Existing EF-REG-004 evidence covers authorized access only and was not repurposed as a failure fixture.

cases.name: EF-REG-011 - Locale-stable currency, compact amount, and date formatting
cases.reason: The current browser/runtime remains Asia/Calcutta and is not configured with the required alternate locale and timezone west of UTC.

cases.name: EF-REG-012 - Runtime configuration, OAuth callback, and startup failure recovery
cases.reason: No isolated invalid or missing-resource configuration was available. The valid connected startup path was not duplicated as evidence for an invalid path.

cases.name: EF-REG-013 - Authorization characterization for approvals and Finance
cases.reason: No dedicated least-privilege employee identity and no separate authorized manager or Finance identity were established in staging; the current Jeet Doshi identity is authorized/admin.

productFailures.summary: Unknown expense route rendered an empty body/root instead of actionable not-found UI.
Narrow connected views had page-level horizontal overflow and off-viewport controls.
The prior Finance ExpenseDate failure was not reproduced after the month-end date-bound fix; this rerun verified the Finance query path through EF-REG-008.

evidence.limitation: The trace contains two setup/transport actions before the first checkpoint; the published step artifacts cover the three canonical steps, and the third is explicitly Restricted.

baselineDecision.reason: Baseline remains unadvanced because six target cases remain blocked, the rerun contains a restricted step, and prior confirmed product failures EF-SMOKE-007 and EF-SMOKE-010 remain open.
